name: Notorious Barbecue
notes: 890 Palomar Airport Rd is Windmill Food Hall, a multi-vendor food hall. Notorious Barbecue is no longer among its current vendors: Google Maps lists Lobster Lab, Thai Style, The Mini Donut Company, El Puerto Street Tacos and Pho Ever Carlsbad at that address instead. Yelp confirms CLOSED. The brand appears to have rebranded/relocated as 'Notorious Sports Bar & Grill' at a different address (6955 El Camino Real Suite 107, Carlsbad, CA 92009, confirmed via its own site's schema.org address) - a different location, so that menu is not filed under this record per the successor rule.
blocked: Windmill Food Hall vendor, no longer on the hall roster; food-hall concession, hold candidate (no independent closure source)

name: Tommy's Pizza & Subs
notes: Restaurant's own domain (tommyspizzasubs.com, linked from the batch's mymenuweb.com listing) has been domain-squatted and now redirects to an unrelated gambling site - not usable. Filed from Uber Eats' embedded Restaurant/Menu JSON-LD (schema.org hasMenu), address matches exactly (8528 Magnolia Avenue, Santee, CA 92071). All 56 non-pizza prices cross-checked to the penny against DoorDash's own embedded Menu JSON-LD for the same store. The 8 pizza items (Classic + Specialty Pizza sections) were excluded: both platforms show them only as a '$24.00+' starting price driven by size/topping selection, with no single fixed price to file. A Facebook post also references pasta dishes (spaghetti, baked penne, lasagna) and a 'Tommy Devito' sandwich not present on either delivery platform's menu - not filed since no price could be confirmed for them.
